points.h: The grid is a route, not a ranking

points.h: Some posts are left unpictured on purpose
points.p: We open every picture before we use it. A handful of posts in this category have a featured image that prints something the store cannot stand behind — a price, a rating, an award, or a product it is not — so those posts appear in the title list rather than as tiles. All eighty posts in the category are still reachable from this page.

points.h: There are no customer reviews, so we quote none
points.p: The store has no customer reviews yet. That is why there is no testimonial block on this page: there is nothing real to put in it, and we have not written any.

The reviews here are written by us rather than supplied by the vendors, and several of them earn a commission if you buy through a link on the post. That is how the blog is paid for. What we sell directly is narrower — the WordPress plugins, the four source-code tools and the Ministry Suite — and every page about those says so.

points.h: If we have not tested it, we do not say we have
points.p: These are researched write-ups, not lab tests. Where a figure comes from the manufacturer — battery life, uptime, speed claims — it is labelled as the manufacturer's own figure rather than ours, and where we think a number looks optimistic we say so on the post.
